description: If a first-order theory \(T\) is preserved under nonempty substructures, its particular universal part \(T_{\forall}\) consists of universal sentences and has exactly the same nonempty models as \(T\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Preservation.universalPart_equivalent.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} (T : L.Theory)
  (hT : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Preservation.SubstructurePreserved T) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Preservation.universalPart T).IsUniversal ∧
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Theories.Equivalent T (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Preservation.universalPart T)
